cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I've been meaning to ask you for some advice about restaurants.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I need to book somewhere to celebrate my sister's 30th birthday, and I liked the sound of

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: that place you went to for your mum's 50th.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The Junction. Yeah, I'd definitely recommend that for a special occasion.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: We had a great time there. Everyone really enjoyed it.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's on Grayson Street, only about a two-minute walk from the station.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh that's good.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I prefer not to have to drive anywhere but I don't want to have to walk too far either.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, the location's perfect, but that's not necessarily why I'd recommend it.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The food's amazing. If you like fish, it's probably the best restaurant in town for that.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's always really fresh and there are lots of interesting dishes to choose from.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: But all the food is good there.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's certainly not cheap, but for a special occasion I think it's fine.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's got a great atmosphere and before dinner you can go up on the roof and have a drink.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's really nice up there, but you need to book.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's very popular as the views are spectacular.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Sounds good. So that's definitely a possibility then.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Is there anywhere else you can think of?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: If you want somewhere a bit less formal, then you could try Paloma.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: No, it's quite new.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's only been open a few months, but it's got a great reputation already.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's in a really beautiful old building on Bow Street.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh, I think I know where you mean. Right beside the cinema.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, that's it. I've only been there a couple of times, but I was really impressed.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The chef used to work at Don Felipe's, apparently.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I was really sorry when that closed down.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yeah.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: You can get lots of small dishes to share, which always works really well if you're in a

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: group.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yeah. There's a lively atmosphere and the waiters are really friendly.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The only thing is that you need to pay a £50 deposit to book a table.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: A lot of restaurants are doing that these days.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I should have a look at the menu to check if there is a good choice of vegetarian dishes.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: A couple of my friends have stopped eating meat.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Not sure – I'd say the selection of those would be quite limited.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I've just thought of another idea. Have you been to the Audley?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: No, don't think I've heard of it. How's it spelt?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: A-U-D-L-E-Y. You must have heard of it. There's been a lot about it in the press.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I don't tend to pay much attention to that kind of thing. So where is it exactly?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's in that hotel near Baxter Bridge, on the top floor.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh, the views would be incredible from up there.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yeah, I'd love to go.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I can't think of the chef's name, but she was a judge on that TV cookery show recently.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And she's written a couple of cookery books.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That's the one. Anyway, it had excellent reviews from all the newspapers.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That would be a memorable place for a celebration.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Definitely!

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Obviously it's worth going there just for the view, but the food is supposed to be really

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: special.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: She only likes cooking with local products, doesn't she?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Everything at the restaurant has to be sourced within a short distance, and absolutely

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: nothing flown in from abroad.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, you could go for the set lunch.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That's quite reasonable for a top class restaurant, £30 a head.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: In the evening, I think it would be more like £50.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: At least that I should think, but I'm sure everyone would enjoy it.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's not the kind of place you leave feeling hungry though, is it? With tiny portions?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: No, the reviews I've read didn't mention that. I imagine they'd be average.
